<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds a controller-manager preStop sleep and longer terminationGracePeriod; migrates Kind/kubeadm test patches from v1beta3 map-style extraArgs to v1beta4 list-style {name,value}; adds an e2e webhook dry-run readiness probe; and raises dev manager zap log level to 6.

## Changes

**Controller and Test Stability Improvements**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Controller Manager graceful shutdown** <br> `config/components/manager/manager.yaml`|Container `lifecycle.preStop` sleeps 10s during shutdown; pod `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` increased from 10 to 30.|
|**Kubeadm v1beta4 migration for kind test clusters** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`, `hack/testing/kind-cluster.yaml`, `hack/testing/kind-cluster-tas.yaml`, `hack/testing/multikueue/manager-cluster.kind.yaml`, `hack/testing/multikueue/worker-cluster.kind.yaml`|All embedded kubeadm patches updated to `kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta4`; `extraArgs` and `kubeletExtraArgs` converted from map form to list-of-`{name,value}` entries while preserving argument values.|
|**E2E webhook dry-run readiness probe** <br> `test/util/e2e.go`|Adds a dry-run `kueue.ResourceFlavor` creation (client.DryRunAll) inside the webhook readiness wait loop to verify apiserver/webhook accepts requests before endpoint checks.|
|**Dev manager log level bump** <br> `config/dev/manager_config_patch.yaml`|Updates manager `--zap-log-level` from `3` to `6` in the dev patch.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

- [kubernetes-sigs/kueue#12037](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/pull/12037): Adds a webhook-readiness dry-run probe in e2e scripts, closely aligned with this PR's webhook dry-run gate.

### Review by [@reruno](https://github.com/reruno) (commented) — 2026-06-12T06:32:04Z

- **test/util/e2e.go:498** by [@reruno](https://github.com/reruno) — 2026-06-12T06:32:04Z
```diff
@@ -498,6 +498,14 @@ func waitForKueueControllerReadyWithWebhookEndpoints(ctx context.Context, k8sCli
 		g.Expect(endpointIPs).To(gomega.Equal(readyPodIPs))
```

  https://storage.googleapis.com/kubernetes-ci-logs/pr-logs/pull/kubernetes-sigs_kueue/12121/pull-kueue-test-e2e-extended-shard-2-main-1-35/2065178188132126720/artifacts/run-test-e2e-extended-1.35.5/kind-create.log
  
  https://storage.googleapis.com/kubernetes-ci-logs/pr-logs/pull/kubernetes-sigs_kueue/12121/pull-kueue-test-e2e-extended-shard-2-main-1-36/2065178191516930048/artifacts/run-test-e2e-extended-1.36.1/kind-create.log
  
  I found interesting difference in kind-create.log between 1.35 and 1.36 k8s versions. 
  
  In 1.36 we have `enable-aggregator-routing=true`, but in 1.35 we don't have `enable-aggregator-routing=true`
  
  1.36
  ```
  DEBUG: config/config.go:96] Using the following kubeadm config for node kind-control-plane:
  apiServer:
    certSANs:
    - localhost
    - 127.0.0.1
    extraArgs:
    - name: runtime-config
      value: ""
    - name: enable-aggregator-routing
      value: "true"
    - name: v
      value: "3"
  ``` 
  1.35
  ```
  DEBUG: config/config.go:96] Using the following kubeadm config for node kind-worker2:
  apiServer:
    certSANs:
    - localhost
    - 127.0.0.1
    extraArgs:
      runtime-config: ""
  ```
  
  Maybe because of that flag for apiserver, we have flakes in 1.35 e2e tests, and that is why apiserver has trouble communicating with kueue webhook service
